card.name: Inside proper names, vowel pieces
card.fires_on: A short vowel-like piece (i, ci, ji, iy, hi, avi) in the middle of a capitalized proper name or place name. It is usually followed by more letters that finish the name.

modes.label: Person names
modes.description: A short piece such as i or avi inside a surname or given name, before the name ends.

modes.label: Place and group names
modes.description: A short piece inside an unusual place or language name.
modes.example: curious absence of red crossbills in the Sisk<<iy>>ous

modes.label: Scientific or religious names
modes.description: A short piece inside a name such as Celsius or Nephi.
modes.example: Boiling Temperature; Air Pressure; Cel<<ci>>us; Oxygen

card.writes: It suppresses some name-piece tokens and promotes odd pieces, so there is no clear output effect beyond name continuation.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a rare name, right after a small letter chunk like "i", when the rest of the name is still coming.
